page0.text:
I'll protect Illya.
I can't protect two people at once.
Tohsaka has Archer, but Illya has nobody else.
So, I have to protect her
in Berserker's place!

page1.text:
"Illya, get down!"
I tackle her to the ground.
Just as I cover her with my body,
my sight and spirit are dyed jet black.

page4.text:
I feel like my body's about to be blown away.
A wave of compressed magical energy erupts into a tempest that violates the whole forest.

page6.text:
My vision is all black.
It's so dark, even though I can see clearly. I must have fallen into a black sun.

page7.text: I have no self. No body.

page8.text:
It must have been melted by the sun.
I have no body.
The complete sensory loss is more revolting than any pain.

page9.text:
"Hah...ah...ah..."
But that's a problem.
I can't protect Illya without my body.
The black Shadow will try to take Illya away.
I use my right arm to resist as best as I can.
I hug Illya with my right arm and hold onto the ground.

page10.text:
"Hah...ah."
That's when I finally realize it.
I do have a body. After all, I can't protect Illya without a body.
...Wow, I'm being so dramatic.
I'm only missing everything from my left shoulder.
It's all gone.
My body is still here. I'm still here.

page12.text:
...
...I'm disappearing.
The Shadow melts away without a trace, as if it's expended all its power.

page13.text:
...Illya's safe.
I don't know what she's saying. Maybe my ears are ringing.

page14.text:
Tohsaka...I wonder how she's doing.
Archer...is there.
His red cloak is soaked in blood, and he looks so weak, like he's about to disappear.

page16.text:
"...Have you lost your mind? If you do that, you'll—"
"There's nothing to consider. If I do nothing, two will die. But if I transplant this, I'm sure to save one.
...At any rate, this body has reached its limit. If I'm going to disappear anyway, then it doesn't hurt to try."

page18.text:
...I wonder what's happening.
In the end, he...
"Normally, he would die. You can't save a person by attaching a spiritual body to theirs. But he and I are a special case. Rin will know what to do once she wakes up."
Just once, he lovingly touches Tohsaka's hair.
